d: In this video, you will learn the five common screen setup mistakes that traders make and how to build an efficient, customised workspace using Kite's Terminal Mode. Organising your trading screen properly is crucial because a cluttered interface can lead to information overload, frequent tab switching, and delayed reactions on active positions. By organising essential tools like charts, options chains, positions, and orders into a single, clean layout, you can keep your focus on execution and reduce unnecessary friction during the trading day.
